title.zh-Hans: I AM GLORIA 2.0 深圳终章首场（2026-09-11）
title.en: I AM GLORIA 2.0 Shenzhen Finale Opening Night (2026-09-11)

notes.zh-Hans: 这份首场实演记录以用户提供的视频章节顺序和时长为主，日期、场馆与《自由的你》首演由官方来源确认，并用用户提供的现场红外激光提示图核对部分舞台 cue。它不是官方 cue sheet；后续十一场可能轮换。“敲鼓”暂映射为 Kingdom Come；现场图中的 G.E.M. / Walk On Water 仅保留为待核验 cue，不额外加入视频章节未单列的歌曲。
notes.en: This opening-night record follows user-provided video chapters and timings. Official sources confirm the date, venue, and premiere of 自由的你, while a user-provided on-site laser warning corroborates selected stage cues. It is not an official cue sheet, and the remaining eleven shows may vary. The drum segment is provisionally mapped to Kingdom Come; G.E.M. / Walk On Water remains an unresolved cue and does not add a song absent from the video chapters.

note.zh-Hans: 与 VCR 1 共用 06:33 视频章节时长。
note.en: Shares the 06:33 video chapter with VCR 1.
First song in the shared 02:56 medley chapter.

note.zh-Hans: 视频章节原文为“爱你A.I.N.Y.2017”；02:56 组合章节的第二首。
note.en: The source labels this “爱你A.I.N.Y.2017”; second song in the shared 02:56 medley chapter.

text.zh-Hans: 串烧：《Where Did U Go》+《等一个他》· 合计 02:34
text.en: Medley: Where Did U Go + 等一个他 · 02:34 total

note.en: First song in the shared 02:34 medley chapter.
Second song in the shared 02:34 medley chapter.

text.zh-Hans: 串烧：《All About U》+《Good to Be Bad》· 合计 02:43
text.en: Medley: All About U + Good to Be Bad · 02:43 total

note.en: First song in the shared 02:43 medley chapter.

note.zh-Hans: 02:43 组合章节的第二首；现场提示图写作“Good to Be Bad”。
note.en: Second song in the shared 02:43 medley chapter; the on-site notice spells the title “Good to Be Bad”.

note.zh-Hans: 视频章节标为“敲鼓”（01:41）；现场红外激光提示图列出 Kingdom Come。暂按该曲的打击乐／缩短现场段落映射，待音频或官方 cue sheet 核验。
note.en: The video chapter says “drum segment” (01:41), while the on-site laser notice lists Kingdom Come. Provisionally mapped as a percussion-led or shortened live segment pending audio or an official cue sheet.

text.zh-Hans: 现场提示组合段：《G.E.M. / Walk On Water》· 视频章节合计 04:12
text.en: On-site cue: G.E.M. / Walk On Water · shared video chapter 04:12

note.zh-Hans: 视频章节标为 Walk On Water（04:12）；现场提示图写作组合 cue“G.E.M. / Walk On Water”。因视频未单列 G.E.M.，本记录不把它另算一首歌。
note.en: The 04:12 video chapter says Walk On Water, while the on-site notice says “G.E.M. / Walk On Water”. Because the video does not list G.E.M. separately, this record does not count it as another song.

note.zh-Hans: 视频章节 · 04:51；官方工作室确认该晚首演未公开的新专辑先行曲。
note.en: Video chapter · 04:51; the artist's official studio confirms the premiere of the unreleased album lead single that night.

text.zh-Hans: 点歌清唱：《画》+《失真》+《让你知道》· 合计 04:31；其他场次可能轮换。
text.en: Request a cappella: 画 + 失真 + 让你知道 · 04:31 total; this segment may vary on other nights.

note.zh-Hans: 04:31 点歌清唱组合段的第一首。
note.en: First song in the shared 04:31 request a cappella segment.

note.zh-Hans: 04:31 点歌清唱组合段的第二首。
note.en: Second song in the shared 04:31 request a cappella segment.

note.zh-Hans: 04:31 点歌清唱组合段的第三首。
note.en: Third song in the shared 04:31 request a cappella segment.

note.zh-Hans: 用户提供的章节清单未标时长。
note.en: No duration was supplied for this final chapter.

sources.title: I AM GLORIA 2.0 Shenzhen opening-night video chapters and timings
sources.notes: User-pasted 42-segment sequence with 41 chapter durations. It is treated as observed performance evidence, not an official cue sheet. The final song has no supplied duration, and medley durations apply to the whole named segment.

sources.title: On-site infrared-laser camera safety notice
sources.notes: The stadium screen lists songs using infrared-laser effects, including Kingdom Come and the combined cue G.E.M./Walk on water. It corroborates selected repertoire but is not a complete running order. The original image remains private and is not committed.

sources.title: Audience discussion about Shenzhen rotations and encore changes
sources.notes: Community comments speculate that the twelve Shenzhen shows share a fixed list and discuss encore changes. These claims are recorded for context only and are not used as an official guarantee of future-night sameness. The original screenshots remain private and are not committed.

sources.title: I AM GLORIA World Tour — Shenzhen dates
sources.notes: Official tour page confirming Shenzhen Universiade Sports Centre Stadium and all twelve Shenzhen dates from 11 September through 5 October 2026. It does not publish a running order.

sources.title: I AM GLORIA Shenzhen finale opening night
sources.notes: Official opening-night recap confirming that 11 September 2026 was the first of twelve Shenzhen shows and that the unreleased album lead single 自由的你 premiered that night. It does not publish the complete running order.

sources.title: Longgang Culture and Tourism Bureau reply on the Shenzhen concert
sources.notes: Government reply confirming twelve performances at Shenzhen Universiade Sports Centre Stadium between 11 September and 5 October 2026. It does not publish a running order.
